messages.subject: Significance scores
parts:
Hello!
Can anybody help me with drawing significance scores in semPath. I use lavaa to cross-lagged panel analysis. And I  need to draw graph like this (whith significanse of parameters)

How can I do it?





clpmС <- '
# synchronous covariances
ses.1 ~~ M152.1
ses.5 ~~ M152.5

# autoregressive + cross-lagged paths
ses.3 ~ ses.1 + M152.1
M152.3 ~ M152.1 + ses.1

ses.5 ~ ses.3 + M152.3
M152.5 ~ M152.3 + ses.3
'
fit_С <- sem(clpmС, data=mydata, fixed.x=FALSE)
summary(fit_С,standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)
semPaths(fit_С, style="mx",
              "est"   ,    # which kind of parameters to plot
         thresholds = TRUE,
         layout="tree2",
         rotation = 2,            # where LVs are located at the plot
         centerLevels=TRUE,
         exoVar=TRUE, residuals=TRUE,equalizeManifests=TRUE,
         sizeMan = 10,            # width of manifest variables
         sizeMan2 = 8,           # height of manifest variables
         sizeLat = 2,            # size of latent variables
         colFactor=0,             # constant color intensity for all edges
         edge.color = "black",    # set color of edges
         edge.label.cex = 0.9, # set size of parameter estimate labels 
         esize = 1,               # width of edges              
         mar = c(11,11,7,11),      
         # margin sizes
         border.width = 0.9,      # width of node borders
         label.prop =1,       # ratio of the label size and the node width
         weighted = FALSE, label.norm="OOOO", asize=2,
         nodeLabels = c("С.Э.С. 2009","Регул. Пит-е 2009","С.Э.С. 2015",
                        "Регул. Пит-е 2015","С.Э.С. 2003","Регул. Пит-е 2003"),
         edge.label.position=c(.5, .5, .5, .25, .5, .25, .5, .35, .5, 
                               .15, NA,NA , NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,NA))
